findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "images" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: image_compress, image_hash · Private data: image_resize, image_convert, image_compress, image_crop, image_rotate, image_thumbnail, image_metadata, image_strip_metadata, image_watermark, image_colors, image_hash, image_favicon, image_blurhash, ocr_image · Public sink: image_colors · Destructive: image_resize, image_convert, image_compress, image_crop, image_rotate, image_thumbnail, image_metadata, image_strip_metadata, image_watermark, image_favicon, ocr_image, make_qr_code, make_barcode.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: image_compress, image_hash · Private data: image_resize, image_convert, image_compress, image_crop, image_rotate, image_thumbnail, image_metadata, image_strip_metadata, image_watermark, image_colors, image_hash, image_favicon, image_blurhash, ocr_image · Public sink: image_colors · Destructive: image_resize, image_convert, image_compress, image_crop, image_rotate, image_thumbnail, image_metadata, image_strip_metadata, image_watermark, image_favicon, ocr_image, make_qr_code, make_barcode

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
